name: People's Speech
description: An open transcribed speech dataset of about 30,000 hours. It includes mixed CC-BY-SA and CC0 licensing; no data is vendored here.
citation: People's Speech: A Large-Scale Diverse English Speech Recognition Dataset for Commercial Usage. Galvez et al. (2021).

license.identifier: Mixed CC-BY-SA and CC0 (not one SPDX identifier for every file)
